description: Tool-selection golden set. The intent branch is FROZEN by the fixture: each case names the agent to exercise directly, so no routing decision is re-made at eval time. Injected `state` is the frozen upstream scratchpad/session context. `gold_tool` is the tool the agent ought to select for that utterance in that context; `none` means (incl. out-of-domain and chat-text "confirmations", see FR-F1) the correct behaviour is to answer or ask a clarifying question WITHOUT calling a tool. The `none` cases are load-bearing: an agent that calls its one tool unconditionally would otherwise score a perfect recall.
